method: built-in image_gen; 8×6 atlas split into native pose tiles
prompt: Create ONE original full bleed illustrated pose-reference contact sheet for an art studio website. Exact 8 columns by 6 rows, 48 square independent tiles, no gutters, no text, no numbers or labels. Every tile shows one full-body clothed young adult illustrated character in a cream shirt and indigo trousers, gender neutral hair, plain ivory or pale pastel studio background. Clear fine linework, softly modeled gouache/anime illustration, natural hands and joints. Each named pose must be clearly different and readable, never substitute standing portrait for floor, jumping or lying pose. Include chair or floor only when needed. Full limbs visible except the two hand-to-face tiles may be waist-up. Order tiles exactly left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1: standing straight, arms relaxed down, front body; 2: standing contrapposto, weight on one leg; 3: both hands on hips, elbows out; 4: standing, arms folded across chest; 5: arms extended sideways, open palms; 6: one arm stretched overhead; 7: back body turning head and shoulder back; 8: one knee on floor, hand over heart; 9: sitting upright on chair, feet grounded; 10: sitting sideways on bench; 11: sitting cross legged on floor; 12: sitting on floor hugging both knees; 13: sitting on floor, legs stretched forward; 14: sitting relaxed against chair back; 15: floor sitting, one knee raised; 16: deep squat, feet grounded; 17: kneeling on one knee, torso upright; 18: kneeling upright on both knees; 19: crawling on hands and knees; 20: low defensive stance, knees bent; 21: lying on back on floor; 22: lying on one side; 23: lying prone supported on elbows, face in hands; 24: reclining sideways on sofa; 25: standing stretch, both arms overhead, tiptoe; 26: walking slowly, relaxed mid stride; 27: walking with very long stride; 28: sprinting, long stride, opposite arms pumping; 29: launching run from crouched start; 30: running away, looking back over shoulder; 31: jumping up, both feet off ground; 32: jumping with one knee lifted, arms up; 33: twisting in the air; 34: landing in deep crouch; 35: floating horizontally in zero gravity; 36: reaching one hand toward viewer; 37: offering both palms forward; 38: waving one hand high; 39: waist-up, one hand on cheek; 40: waist-up, index finger near lips; 41: sitting reading open book; 42: standing holding bouquet; 43: sitting holding cup in both hands; 44: standing playing acoustic guitar; 45: sitting painting at easel; 46: dancing twirl, one foot pivot; 47: ballet arabesque, straight rear leg, graceful arms; 48: leaning on wall, one foot bent. No Halloween objects, magic costumes, pumpkins, moons or brand marks. Keep exactly 8 by 6 grid. Original professional visual references with broad natural body movement.
